data.title: PeptidePal – Peptide Tracker
data.description:
PeptidePal is a peptide and GLP-1 protocol tracker used by over 150,000 people — dose logging, vial inventory, injection site rotation, scheduling, and a 110+ compound library in one app.

Whether you're on a prescribed GLP-1, running your first protocol, or managing several compounds on different schedules, PeptidePal keeps it all in one place.

WHY PEPTIDEPAL?

◉ BUILT FOR PROTOCOLS AND PILLS: Generic medication apps track one pill, once a day. PeptidePal handles mcg, mg, IU and mL, cycles, on/off weeks, site rotation, and vial lifecycle.

◉ NO DRIFT: Three weeks in, it's easy to lose track of whether you're on day 9 or day 12. PeptidePal keeps the protocol you designed and the protocol you're running the same thing.

MAIN FEATURES:

▶ PROTOCOL BUILDER Build from the library or from scratch. Set dose (mcg, mg, IU, mL), frequency (daily, every other day, twice weekly, 5-on/2-off, custom), days, start date, notes, and reminders. Run multiple protocols side by side.

▶ DOSE LOGGING & CALENDAR One tap to log. A week strip and monthly calendar show completed and planned doses, injection site, and time. Streaks keep you consistent.

▶ VIAL INVENTORY & SUPPLY ALERTS Log fill size, concentration, and expiry. PeptidePal projects each vial's run-out date from your live schedule and warns you about a week ahead.

▶ INJECTION SITE ROTATION Tap-to-select on an interactive body map, with recently used sites heat-mapped so your rotation is visible at a glance.

▶ COMPOUND LIBRARY 50+ profiles in plain English: mechanism, half-life, research status, reported side effects, and considerations. Every entry states its regulatory status.

▶ NUTRITION TRACKER Stay on top of the nutrients your body needs in order to successfully manage your protocols. See what foods are beloved by the community.

▶ PROGRESS & LEVELS Weight and body-composition charts, progress photos with compare and time-lapse, and an estimated on-board level curve from your logged doses. Educational estimate, not a measurement.

▶ AI ADVISOR & COMMUNITY Q&A Short, plain-English answers to educational questions, plus a moderated peer forum. The AI will not recommend a dose, titration, or protocol, and routes medical questions to a provider. You're talking to an AI, not a clinician.

Does PeptidePal work with prescribed GLP-1s? Yes — track Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro® or Zepbound® with the same scheduling, rotation, and supply tools. Dosing decisions belong with your prescriber.

Is my data safe with PeptidePal?

Protocol data is stored on your device
Progress photos are stripped of metadata before storage
We do not sell your data or share health information with advertisers
Delete your account and your associated data from Settings, in two steps. See our privacy policy for details about data deletion and retention. 

Medical disclaimer PeptidePal is a tracking and educational tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, does not recommend doses or protocols, and is not a substitute for a licensed healthcare provider. Many compounds in the library are not approved by the FDA or other regulators for human use. Always consult a qualified clinician before starting, stopping, or changing anything. 18+ only.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO:

Free to download. Protocol tracking, the full library, advanced analytics, and AI chat require a subscription.
Prices are shown in the app and charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
Renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Manage or cancel anytime in App Store account settings.

Terms: https://peptidepal.health/terms 
Privacy: https://peptidepal.health/privacy

Trademarks are property of their respective owners. PeptidePal is not affiliated with or endorsed by any pharmaceutical manufacturer.
